title: Political Rhetoric: Rhetorical Questions
goal: I can ask a rhetorical question in a political text (*vajon …?, nemde éppen …?*).
I can name the main terms of political communication (*retorikai keretezés, narratívaépítés, demagógia*).
I can say what framing and demagoguery are.
